mapper.sql: change_id AS changeId, client_id AS clientId, change_type AS changeType, from_tier AS fromTier, to_tier AS toTier, status, pending_slot AS pendingSlot, approval_level AS approvalLevel, crr_snapshot AS crrSnapshot, underwriting_id AS underwritingId, reason, go_live_note AS goLiveNote, chk_qualification_status AS chkQualificationStatus, chk_qualification_valid_to AS chkQualificationValidTo, chk_underwriting_version_no AS chkUnderwritingVersionNo, chk_agreement_id AS chkAgreementId, chk_agreement_status AS chkAgreementStatus, chk_enabled_capabilities AS chkEnabledCapabilities, chk_pending_capabilities AS chkPendingCapabilities, chk_channel_registration AS chkChannelRegistration, chk_integration AS chkIntegration, chk_production_verified AS chkProductionVerified, chk_open_issues_cleared AS chkOpenIssuesCleared, observation_target_days AS observationTargetDays, observation_target_transactions AS observationTargetTransactions, observation_days_at_request AS observationDaysAtRequest, observation_allowed_at_request AS observationAllowedAtRequest, requested_by AS requestedBy, requested_time AS requestedTime, decided_by AS decidedBy, decided_time AS decidedTime, decision_comment AS decisionComment, version, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_client_limit_tier_change(change_id, client_id, change_type, from_tier, to_tier, status, pending_slot, approval_level, crr_snapshot, underwriting_id, reason, go_live_note, chk_qualification_status, chk_qualification_valid_to, chk_underwriting_version_no, chk_agreement_id, chk_agreement_status, chk_enabled_capabilities, chk_pending_capabilities, chk_channel_registration, chk_integration, chk_production_verified, chk_open_issues_cleared, observation_target_days, observation_target_transactions, observation_days_at_request, observation_allowed_at_request, requested_by, requested_time, decided_by, decided_time, decision_comment, version, create_time, update_time) VALUES(#{row.changeId}, #{row.clientId}, #{row.changeType}, #{row.fromTier}, #{row.toTier}, #{row.status}, #{row.pendingSlot}, #{row.approvalLevel}, #{row.crrSnapshot}, #{row.underwritingId}, #{row.reason}, #{row.goLiveNote}, #{row.chkQualificationStatus}, #{row.chkQualificationValidTo}, #{row.chkUnderwritingVersionNo}, #{row.chkAgreementId}, #{row.chkAgreementStatus}, #{row.chkEnabledCapabilities}, #{row.chkPendingCapabilities}, #{row.chkChannelRegistration}, #{row.chkIntegration}, #{row.chkProductionVerified}, #{row.chkOpenIssuesCleared}, #{row.observationTargetDays}, #{row.observationTargetTransactions}, #{row.observationDaysAtRequest}, #{row.observationAllowedAtRequest}, #{row.requestedBy}, #{row.requestedTime}, #{row.decidedBy}, #{row.decidedTime}, #{row.decisionComment}, #{row.version}, #{row.createTime}, #{row.updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_client_limit_tier_change WHERE change_id IN #{id}
SELECT FROM t_client_limit_tier_change WHERE client_id = #{clientId} AND pending_slot = 1
SELECT FROM t_client_limit_tier_change WHERE client_id = #{clientId} ORDER BY requested_time DESC, change_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_client_limit_tier_change SET status = #{status}, pending_slot = NULL, decided_by = #{decidedBy}, decided_time = #{now}, decision_comment = #{comment}, version = version + 1, update_time = #{now} WHERE change_id = #{row.changeId} AND version = #{row.version} AND status = 'PENDING' AND pending_slot = 1
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_client_limit_tier_change WHERE status = 'PENDING'
